wheels_pep.title: Big Wheels Roll & Roll  Max and Mia Bus Adventure!
wheels_pep.description:
Hop on the bus with Max and Mia for a sunny adventure! Round and round the big wheels spin through town. Perfect bouncy song for toddlers and preschoolers!

Follow Max and Mia World for more nursery rhymes, learning songs, and Pixar-style adventures!

#KidsSongs #NurseryRhymes #MaxAndMia

twinkle_lullaby.title: Shiny Shiny Tiny Gem  Max and Mia Lullaby (Sleep Song)
twinkle_lullaby.description:
A gentle lullaby to soothe little ones to sleep. Watch Max and Mia drift through a starry sky with twinkling gems and a smiling moon.

Perfect for bedtime, nap time, and quiet play. Soft orchestral lullaby for babies and toddlers.

#Lullaby #BedtimeSong #KidsSleep #MaxAndMia

oldmac.title: Old MacDonald Had a Farm  Max and Mia Farm Animals Song
oldmac.description:
EE-I-EE-I-O! Join Max and Mia on Old MacDonald's farm to meet all the animals — cow, pig, duck, sheep, horse, and more! Country folk fun for kids.

Learn animal sounds with Max and Mia World!

#OldMacDonald #FarmAnimals #KidsSongs #MaxAndMia

babyshark.title: Shark Family Dance  Max and Mia Underwater Adventure!
babyshark.description:
Doo doo doo! Dive into the ocean with Max and Mia to meet the shark family and dance with all their reef friends!

Tropical bouncy fun for kids who love the sea!

#SharkSong #OceanSongs #KidsSongs #MaxAndMia

hickory.title: Tickety Tocketty Toe  Max and Mia Mouse and Clock Song
hickory.description:
Tick tock! The mouse ran up the clock! Watch Max and Mia laugh as silly mice climb a big grandfather clock in this playful comedy song.

A fun spin on the classic clock nursery rhyme!

#KidsSongs #NurseryRhymes #MaxAndMia

row.title: Row Row Row Your Boat  Max and Mia Lake Adventure
row.description:
Gently down the stream! Row with Max and Mia across a peaceful lake at golden hour, meeting friendly woodland animals along the way.

A calm folk song perfect for kids!

#RowRowRow #KidsSongs #NurseryRhymes #MaxAndMia
